instruction: Generate a table of contents for in/GUIDE.md into out/TOC.md. Include only level-2 (##) and level-3 (###) headings outside ``` fenced blocks, in order, as '- [Heading](#slug)'; level-3 entries are indented by two spaces. slug = heading lowercased with each run of non [a-z0-9] characters replaced by '-' and leading/trailing '-' removed.
note: All paths are relative to the workspace root.
